title: Find the Percentage Marks Obtained by a Student

blocks.content: Find the Percentage Marks Obtained by a Student

items: Create a double array marks with length 4 to store the marks obtained by the student.
Get input values for the array.
Find the sum of all obtained marks.
Create a total_marks variable and assign value 400.0 to it.
Find the percentage obtained by the student and print it.
